_comment: Human-owned. A story id published in an earlier release that a later release may no longer serve. Every entry needs: reason (withdrawn | merged | error), on (YYYY-MM-DD), note (why, in a sentence a reader can be shown), and target (the story id that replaces it; merged only). The uploader REFUSES a public release that silently drops a published story id that is not listed here — old bookmarked story URLs stay valid (plan T1.5).
